name: Playtest Operator
tagline: Uses your product the way a customer would and reports each failure
description: When API checks are not enough, it exercises the product the way a person would: working the interface on actual hardware, walking the paths a customer would take, recording each failure as it happens and sending back a tight findings pack. The result is QA evidence about the experience, not just the endpoints.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
